questions.chapter: Introduction to CAD Software & GUI Environment (AutoCAD)
questions.text: Explain the advantages of Computer Aided Design and Drafting (CADD) over traditional manual drafting in civil engineering projects. Explain CAD coordinate systems: Absolute Coordinate System $(X, Y)$, Relative Rectangular Coordinate System $(@\Delta X, \Delta Y)$, and Relative Polar Coordinate System $(@\text{Distance} < \text{Angle})$.

questions.chapter: Introduction to CAD Software & GUI Environment (AutoCAD)
questions.text: Explain CAD Environment setup: `LIMITS`, `UNITS`, `GRID`, `SNAP`, `ORTHO`, `OSNAP` (Object Snap: Endpoint, Midpoint, Center, Intersection, Perpendicular, Tangent), and dynamic input.

questions.chapter: 2D Drafting Tools, Geometric Constructions & Layer Management
questions.text: Explain 2D Drawing Commands: `LINE`, `PLINE` (Polyline), `RECTANGLE`, `CIRCLE`, `ARC`, `ELLIPSE`, `POLYGON`, `SPLINE`, `HATCH` (Patterns, Scale, Angle, Associativity), and `REGION`. Differentiate between `LINE` and `PLINE`.

questions.chapter: 2D Drafting Tools, Geometric Constructions & Layer Management
questions.text: Explain 2D Modification and Editing Commands: `MOVE`, `COPY`, `ROTATE`, `SCALE`, `OFFSET`, `TRIM`, `EXTEND`, `FILLET`, `CHAMFER`, `MIRROR`, `ARRAY` (Rectangular & Polar Array), `EXPLODE`, and `JOIN`.

questions.chapter: 2D Drafting Tools, Geometric Constructions & Layer Management
questions.text: Explain Layer Management in AutoCAD: Layer Name, Color, Linetype (`LTSCALE`), Lineweight, On/Off, Freeze/Thaw, Lock/Unlock, and Plot/No-Plot. Why is standard layer structuring essential in architectural drawing submissions to municipal authorities (e.g. Kathmandu Valley Development Authority - KVDA)?

questions.chapter: 2D Drafting Tools, Geometric Constructions & Layer Management
questions.text: Explain Blocks and Attributes: `BLOCK`, `WBLOCK`, `INSERT`, `ATTDEF` (Attribute Definition), and `BEDIT` (Block Editor). How are title blocks and dynamic doors/windows created with attributes?

questions.chapter: Architectural Planning & Residential Building Working Drawings
questions.text:
Prepare a complete Architectural Working Drawing set for a two-story residential building conforming to National Building Code (NBC) and municipal bylaws:
(a) Ground Floor Plan and First Floor Plan showing room dimensions, wall thicknesses, door/window schedules
(b) Front Elevation and Side Elevation
(c) Longitudinal and Cross Section through staircase and toilet showing footing, plinth, sill, lintel, and roof slab levels
(d) Site Plan showing plot boundary, setback lines ($1.5\,\text{m}-3.0\,\text{m}$), access road, and north arrow.

questions.chapter: Structural Detailing (RCC Beams, Columns, Slabs & Footings)
questions.text:
Prepare CAD Structural Detailing drawings according to NBC 105 and IS 13920 Ductile Detailing code for:
(a) Longitudinal and cross-sectional reinforcement detailing of an RCC Continuous Beam ($300\,\text{mm} \times 450\,\text{mm}$) showing main tensile steel, curtailment points, development lengths ($L_d$), and confining stirrup spacing
(b) Column-Beam Joint detailing with ductile confining links
(c) Isolated Column Footing detailing in plan and section.

questions.chapter: Structural Detailing (RCC Beams, Columns, Slabs & Footings)
questions.text: Prepare structural reinforcement layout for a Doglegged RCC Staircase showing waist slab thickness, main bottom bars, distribution bars, top negative bars, and landing support details.

questions.chapter: 3D Modeling, Rendering & Building Information Modeling (BIM)
questions.text: Explain 3D Solid Modeling operations in AutoCAD: `EXTRUDE`, `PRESSPULL`, `REVOLVE`, `LOFT`, `SWEEP`, and Boolean operations (`UNION`, `SUBTRACT`, `INTERSECT`). Model a 3D isometric view of a residential building.

questions.chapter: 3D Modeling, Rendering & Building Information Modeling (BIM)
questions.text: Explain User Coordinate System (UCS) in 3D CAD (`UCS` by 3 points, Face UCS, World Coordinate System - WCS) and 3D navigation (`3DORBIT`, `VIEWCUBE`, Visual Styles: Wireframe, Conceptual, Realistic, Shaded).

questions.chapter: 3D Modeling, Rendering & Building Information Modeling (BIM)
questions.text: Explain Building Information Modeling (BIM) principles: 3D parametric modeling, 4D time scheduling, 5D cost estimating, 6D sustainability, and 7D facility management. Compare CAD (AutoCAD) vs BIM (Revit / ArchiCAD).

questions.chapter: Introduction to CAD Software & GUI Environment (AutoCAD)
questions.text: Explain View Navigation tools in CAD: `ZOOM` (All, Window, Extents, Realtime, Dynamic), `PAN`, `VIEWPORTS`, and Model Space vs Paper Space (`LAYOUT` / `TILEMODE`).

questions.chapter: Architectural Planning & Residential Building Working Drawings
questions.text: Explain Dimensioning in CAD: Linear, Aligned, Angular, Radius, Diameter, Leader (`MLEADER`), and `DIMSTYLE` customization (Dimension text, arrows, scale factor, primary units, tolerance).

questions.chapter: Structural Detailing (RCC Beams, Columns, Slabs & Footings)
questions.text: Explain CAD drawing export, plotting, and printing: Page Setup Manager, Plot Styles (`monochrome.ctb` vs `acad.ctb`), scale setting ($1:50, 1:100$), and PDF/DWF export.
